name: xmldoc
input_api: new XmlDocument(xml: string) (ESM import { XmlDocument } from 'xmldoc'), after strict UTF-8 TextDecoder of local bytes; the result is read through the documented members name, attr and children (type element, text, cdata, comment) and doctype
license_evidence: package/LICENSE in the pinned npm tarball (MIT), byte-identical to LICENSE at npm gitHead 3a5eb7c0
scope: One UTF-8 local document through xmldoc's in-memory tree: the root element and its descendants with raw qualified element and attribute names (prefix:local, no namespace URIs), attribute order and decoded values, xmlns/xmlns:* as ordinary attributes, decoded text and CDATA, comments inside the root, CDATA count, tree depth and the doctype string (empty; no DOCTYPE in either control)
well_formedness_checking: partial: strict sax errors thrown during write(); close() is never called, so end-of-document checks are not run
family: sax-js strict XML state machine (sax 1.6.1 in non-namespace mode), shared with the selected sax path, xml2js and xml-js
family_note: xmldoc has no tokenizer of its own. dist/index.js creates sax.parser(true) (strict, no xmlns option), writes the trimmed string once and builds XmlElement/XmlTextNode/XmlCDataNode/XmlCommentNode objects from onopentag, onclosetag, ontext, oncdata, oncomment and ondoctype; onerror rethrows. Its ^1.6.0 range resolves to sax 1.6.1, the same release as the selected sax path. sax runs here without namespace processing, so this is a raw-name XML tree path, not an XML 1.0 + Namespaces parser.

popularity.limitation: Package-wide npm downloads over all versions, including the 1.x/2.x CommonJS lines still pulled by dependents; it is an adoption proxy for the package, not for the 3.0.0 ESM release or for any particular input. The count is also not added to sax's: xmldoc downloads pull sax transitively.

oracle: projects/xml/javascript/xmldoc/oracle.py (Python expat without namespace processing, ordered attributes, comments and text inside the root only, processing instructions ignored)
verification_note: Measured as a raw-name XML tree path, not as a namespace-aware XML parser. xmldoc documents that namespaces are ignored (<office:body> becomes "office:body"), so prefixes, local names, attribute order and xmlns declarations are compared as raw qualified-name strings; no namespace URI, expanded name or in-scope binding is produced by xmldoc or inferred by the harness. The comparison oracle is expat in non-namespace mode restricted to what the tree keeps. Fields xmldoc exposes but the oracle cannot (line, column, position, startTagPosition, val) are not compared.
data_loss: Namespace URIs: none are produced. In order-default-ns.xml, <plain xmlns=""> is only the attribute string 'xmlns=' and order/line/sku/plain/leaf share the unprefixed names; a consumer cannot tell that order, line and sku are in urn:parsarium:order while plain and leaf are in no namespace. Equal qualified names with different bindings, or different prefixes for one URI, are indistinguishable without consumer-side resolution.

Processing instructions are not kept: the XML declarations of both controls and <?audit step="1"?> in order-default-ns.xml are absent from the tree, and text split only by a PI is not distinguishable from one run.
Comments and text before or after the root element are dropped by design (CHANGELOG 3.0.0); the order control's prolog comment ' order receipt ' is not in the tree.
attr is a plain object keyed by qualified name; sax strict mode rejects duplicates, so no attribute is lost on valid input.
source_read_limits: The constructor runs xml.toString().trim() before parsing, so leading and trailing whitespace (and a leading U+FEFF, which String.prototype.trim removes) never reaches sax. Not exercised: only valid controls were run.

parser.write(xml) is not followed by parser.close(), so sax's end-of-input checks (unclosed elements, missing root) never run; truncated documents can return a partial tree. Read from dist/index.js only; no malformed input was run.
sax.parser(true) without strictEntities uses sax's HTML entity table for named references. Read from sax lib/sax.js only; not exercised.

The TypeScript signature is constructor(xml: string). A Buffer works only through xml.toString(), which decodes UTF-8 with replacement characters; the harness passes a strictly decoded string instead.
